description: Implement the redesigned mohist/github-pr workflow lifecycle: remove VerifyTask, add retry:self + nested onFailure + failIf to the engine, split/rename the GitHub PR runner actions, add rebase conflictMode:task and a consolidated openspec-artifacts check, assemble the mohist/github-pr profile, and ripple the profile rename through read surfaces, docs, and fixtures.

tasks.title: Remove VerifyTask from CheckFailureRepair across domain, serializer, surrogate, scanner, and run pipeline
tasks.description: Collapse CheckFailureRepair(Limit, Task, VerifyTask?) to CheckFailureRepair(Limit, Task). Remove the VerifyTask field from the Orleans surrogate and its converter, drop verifyTask parsing/emission in WorkflowYamlSerializer, stop scanning it in PromptReferenceScanner, and remove the append-repair.VerifyTask step in WorkflowRun.Check.cs. Rewrite every test that pins VerifyTask (MohistDefaultWorkflowProfileSpecs, MohistPrIssueWorkflowProfileSpecs, CheckRetrySpecs, PromptReferenceScannerSpecs, WorkflowCheckLoopArtifactSpecs) to assert the check-repair path is exactly [repairTask] with no verify step. This is the foundational cleanup that lets onFailure become the single recovery mechanism.
acceptanceCriteria: No VerifyTask symbol remains in packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Workflow (record, surrogate, serializer, scanner, run pipeline)
CheckFailureRepair is a 2-field record (Limit, Task)
WorkflowYamlSerializer round-trips a check with only repairTask/repairLimit and no longer accepts verifyTask (unknown-key behavior unchanged, but no verifyTask is emitted or parsed)
WorkflowRun check-failure recovery appends exactly the repair task and nothing else
PromptReferenceScanner no longer traverses a VerifyTask branch
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with warnings-as-errors; rewritten unit tests cover check-repair-without-verify, serializer round-trip, and scanner output
tasks.output: Updated CheckFailureRepair record, surrogate converter, WorkflowYamlSerializer, PromptReferenceScanner, WorkflowRun.Check.cs, and rewritten server unit tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decision D1. VerifyTask removal is additive-safe (nullable field dropped); no storage migration because the surrogate slot is reused/removed in the same change.

tasks.title: Add retry:self and nested (non-recursive) onFailure recovery to the workflow engine
tasks.description: Extend TaskFailureCase with a RetrySelf flag (parsed from case 'retry: self'). In WorkflowGrain.ResolveTaskFailureRecovery, when the matched case sets RetrySelf, append a fresh TaskDefinition clone of the failed task (preserving OnFailure) after the case's recovery tasks, so subsequent failures re-enter recovery and count against Limit. Support one level of nested onFailure on recovery tasks: ResolveTaskFailureRecovery recurses once when a recovery task fails, matching that recovery task's own onFailure against its output. Enforce non-recursion at parse time in WorkflowYamlSerializer (ParseTaskFailureAction gains an allowNestedOnFailure flag; recovery-task parsing passes true, its recovery tasks pass false). Add the ${{ failure.output }} template context for recovery task input expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: A task failing with a matching case declaring retry: self gets its recovery tasks followed by a new attempt of the original task id, and the new attempt preserves the original onFailure
Retried-attempt failures re-evaluate onFailure and count against the original Limit; exhaustion surfaces an ordinary failure
A recovery task with its own onFailure triggers nested recovery exactly one level deep against the recovery task's output
WorkflowYamlSerializer rejects (clear error) an onFailure declared on a recovery task's own recovery tasks (depth >= 2)
Recovery task 'with' inputs can reference ${{ failure.output.* }} and are template-expanded
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds; unit tests cover retry-self re-enqueue with preserved onFailure, nested recovery (rebase-conflict shape), limit exhaustion, and parse-time depth rejection
tasks.output: Updated TaskFailureCase (RetrySelf), WorkflowGrain.ResolveTaskFailureRecovery, WorkflowYamlSerializer parse validation, template context for failure.output, and unit tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decisions D2 and D3. Bounded recursion (depth 1) is enforced at parse time so runtime matching stays simple. The rebase-conflict path in T-005's profile is the canonical nested case.

tasks.title: Add failIf marker matching that fails the task with the action's own errorCode
tasks.description: Extend expect.markers parsing (WorkflowYamlSerializer + TaskRun required-file extraction) to accept oneOf together with a failIf value, and thread failIf through to the runner expectations evaluator (expectations.ts). When a produced marker equals failIf, the runner reports the task result as failed, carrying the action's own errorCode from the action output (not an engine-synthesized code). When failIf is absent or the marker does not equal failIf, current pass behavior is unchanged. Ensure the engine treats the reported failure like any other task failure and applies onFailure.
acceptanceCriteria: A task declaring expect.markers[*].oneOf:[PASS,FAIL] + failIf:FAIL fails when the produced marker is FAIL
The failed task's errorCode comes from the action output (e.g. review-failed), not a synthesized engine code
A task declaring failIf:FAIL whose marker is PASS does not fail on account of the marker
A failIf-induced failure still triggers the task's declared onFailure recovery
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and dotnet build Mohist.sln succeed; runner + server tests cover failIf-fails-task, failIf-passes, and failIf-drives-onFailure
tasks.output: Updated expect.markers parsing (failIf), runner expectations.ts, TaskRun required-file extraction, and runner/server unit tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decision D4. Marker matching stays runner-owned so the pass/fail decision is not split across processes; the server just consumes the reported failed result.

tasks.title: Rename/split GitHub PR runner actions: create-github-pr, mark-github-pr-ready, push (forceWithLease), merge-github-pr
tasks.description: In packages/runner/src/actions, rename create-pull-request -> create-github-pr (push workflow branch, create/reuse draft PR, emit prNumber/prUrl) and merge-pull-request -> merge-github-pr (wait PR checks, squash merge, confirm MERGED, return errorCode base-moved / pr-checks-failed on recoverable failures). Add a new mark-github-pr-ready action (idempotent: success when PR already ready; takes prNumber only; no push, no title/body update). Extend mohist/push with a forceWithLease option for post-rebase history rewrites. Update registry.ts registrations. Keep mohist/merge-ready registered if mohist/default still uses it; retire publish-via-pr if nothing references it after the profile swap.
acceptanceCriteria: mohist/create-github-pr pushes the branch and creates/reuses a draft PR, returning output.prNumber and output.prUrl

mohist/merge-github-pr waits for PR checks, performs gh pr merge --squash, re-queries and confirms state=MERGED, and returns errorCode base-moved or pr-checks-failed (with prNumber/prUrl/message) on recoverable failures
mohist/mark-github-pr-ready is idempotent: marking an already-ready PR succeeds without mutation
mohist/push accepts forceWithLease and uses --force-with-lease when set
registry.ts registers all four actions under their new names; stale registrations removed where unused
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner succeed; action unit tests cover create/reuse, idempotent ready, forceWithLease push, and both merge errorCodes
tasks.output: Renamed/new runner action modules (create-github-pr, mark-github-pr-ready, push, merge-github-pr), updated registry.ts, and action unit tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decision D5 (runner side). Uses Fake git/gh per AGENTS.md testing rules — no real GitHub API calls.

tasks.title: Add conflictMode:task to mohist/rebase (returns failureKind:conflict, leaves rebase in progress)
tasks.description: Add a conflictMode input to mohist/rebase ('resolve' default preserving today's inline conflictResolver behavior, 'task' new). In 'task' mode, on conflict the action does not invoke the inline conflictResolver, does not abort, returns { failureKind: 'conflict', ... } with the conflicting files, and leaves the rebase in progress so a subsequent recover:resolve-rebase-conflicts agent task can resolve and complete it. The existing abortRebaseIfInProgress self-heal at the top of each invocation is preserved so a re-run is safe.
acceptanceCriteria: mohist/rebase with conflictMode:task and a conflict returns output.failureKind == 'conflict' and does NOT abort the in-progress rebase
mohist/rebase with conflictMode:resolve (default) preserves prior inline-agent conflict-resolution behavior unchanged
Re-running mohist/rebase after an abandoned in-progress rebase still aborts the prior rebase before starting (self-heal)
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner succeed; tests cover task-mode-conflict-returns-and-leaves-in-progress, resolve-mode-unchanged, and self-heal-on-rerun
tasks.output: Updated rebase.ts (conflictMode input + task-mode branch) and unit tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decision D6. The in-progress rebase is intentional; the resolve-rebase-conflicts agent task (declared in the profile, T-007) completes it.

tasks.title: Add consolidated mohist/openspec-artifacts plan check action
tasks.description: Add a read-only mohist/openspec-artifacts action that verifies the four plan artifacts (proposal.md, specs/, design.md, tasks.json) all exist under the supplied changeDir, replacing the four separate core/artifact-exists checks. Register it in registry.ts alongside the other mohist/openspec-* actions. The action takes only changeDir and returns a structured pass/fail with the list of missing artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: mohist/openspec-artifacts succeeds when proposal.md, specs/, design.md, and tasks.json all exist under changeDir
mohist/openspec-artifacts fails with a clear message listing the missing artifacts when any are absent
registry.ts registers mohist/openspec-artifacts
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner succeed; tests cover all-present, each-single-missing, and changeDir-only input
tasks.output: New openspec-artifacts action module, registry.ts registration, and unit tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decision D7. Pure read-only filesystem check; uses Fake fs per AGENTS.md.

tasks.title: Assemble the mohist/github-pr profile YAML and register it in the catalog (retire mohist/pr)
tasks.description: Add packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/WorkflowProfiles/mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml matching design/workflow/builtin-workflows/github-pr.md exactly: plan ends with self-review (failIf:FAIL + onFailure auto-fix + retry:self) then open-draft-pr (create-github-pr, setVars github.pr.number/url); single openspec-artifacts plan check; build stage unchanged shape; check stage ai-review (failIf + auto-fix + retry:self) -> push -> mark-pr-ready plus read-only github-pr-status check; integrate spec-sync -> archive-change -> push -> merge-pr with onFailure base-moved (rebase conflictMode:task -> resolve-rebase-conflicts nested onFailure -> push -> retry:self) and pr-checks-failed (fix-pr-checks -> push -> retry:self), plus merge-verified github-pr-status expect:merged check. All prompts via ${{ prompts.xxx }} named refs; task ids have no stage prefixes, recovery tasks use recover:. Register mohist/github-pr in the workflow profile catalog and retire/remove mohist-pr.workflow.yaml. Provide the named prompt entries the profile references.
acceptanceCriteria: The built-in catalog exposes mohist/github-pr and no longer exposes mohist/pr

Profile parses via WorkflowYamlSerializer: open-draft-pr is the last plan task, draft PR setVars github.pr.number/url, single openspec-artifacts plan check, check stage has exactly ai-review/push/mark-pr-ready + github-pr-status check, integrate has spec-sync/archive-change/push/merge-pr + merge-verified check
merge-pr.onFailure declares both base-moved (rebase conflictMode:task with nested resolve-rebase-conflicts -> push -> retry:self) and pr-checks-failed (fix-pr-checks -> push -> retry:self)
All task prompts are named references; no inline prompt strings; task ids have no stage prefixes and recovery tasks use recover:
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds; profile-spec tests (replacing MohistPrIssueWorkflowProfileSpecs) assert the full graph, action names, setVars, onFailure cases, and nested recovery
tasks.output: New mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml, catalog registration, named prompt entries, removed mohist-pr.workflow.yaml, and rewritten profile spec tests
tasks.dependsOnRationale: Profile consumes retry:self + nested onFailure (T-002), failIf (T-003), the renamed/split actions (T-004), rebase conflictMode:task (T-005), and openspec-artifacts (T-006).
tasks.notes: Implements design decision D5 (profile side). This is the integration point that exercises every engine/runner capability added above.

tasks.title: Ripple the mohist/pr -> mohist/github-pr rename through read surfaces, CLI/web fixtures, and docs
tasks.description: Update every reference to the built-in mohist/pr id to mohist/github-pr in: docs/workflow-profiles.md, CLI fixture assertions and any web fixtures that assert against the built-in PR profile id, and any server read-surface/catalog tests that enumerate built-in profiles. Leave test code that uses mohist/pr purely as an arbitrary opaque profile-id string (not asserting built-in catalog membership) untouched where it does not claim to test the built-in profile. Verify mo issue show and the workflow-profile endpoint surface mohist/github-pr for an issue created with --workflow-profile mohist/github-pr.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/workflow-profiles.md documents mohist/github-pr (not mohist/pr) as the built-in PR profile
CLI/web fixtures asserting the built-in PR profile id assert mohist/github-pr
mo issue create --workflow-profile mohist/github-pr followed by mo issue show displays profile: mohist/github-pr across detail, list, and workflow-profile endpoint
npm run typecheck -w packages/web, npm run test:run -w packages/web, dotnet test for CLI/server profile fixtures, and dotnet build Mohist.sln all succeed
No stale mohist/pr reference remains in docs/ or in fixtures that claim to test the built-in profile
tasks.output: Updated docs/workflow-profiles.md, CLI/web/server fixtures, and regression tests
tasks.notes: Aligns read surfaces and documentation with the renamed catalog entry from T-007. Satisfies the issue-workflow-profile MODIFIED spec.
